title: whatsapp_inbox._quota.set
description: The monthly WhatsApp allowance billing granted this hub, and how much of it the platform has already counted as spent. Written ONLY by the runtime's Cloud-facing sync (whatsapp_inbox#37): the command is internal, so no screen, API key or assistant can reach it.

monthly_limit.description: Billable messages per calendar month the plan allows. 0 = no cap (unmetered plan, or a hub billing has not spoken about yet).

monthly_usage.description: Billable messages already spent this calendar month, as the platform counts them (`usage.billable_messages`, whatsapp_inbox#155). OPTIONAL on purpose: the hub omits the key on a tick where the platform did not report a usable spend, and the cap has to keep arriving on that tick — an absence means «I do not know» and preserves the stored spend, while a 0 that does arrive is a fact and is written.
